kicker: YOUR AGE MATES WILL ASK WHAT CHANGED
title: 8 habits that make a man *look younger*

items.head: Don't smoke
items.sub: Smokers' skin wrinkles years early. Vapes don't get a pass.

items.head: Cut sugar and alcohol
items.sub: Both show up as a puffy face and a soft middle.

items.head: Walk 8,000+ steps a day
items.sub: Walks after meals count. So does pacing on calls.

items.head: Sleep 8 hours
items.sub: Same bedtime every night, weekends too.

items.head: No caffeine after 2PM
items.sub: Late coffee cuts deep sleep even when you fall asleep fine.

label: HABIT 7
head: Eat 90% whole food
sub: Meat, eggs, rice, fruit, vegetables. The label with 20 ingredients is the 10%.

label: HABIT 8
head: Sunscreen every morning
sub: The sun does most of the visible aging on your face. SPF 30, even when it's cloudy.

text: Younger can't be bought. *Sleep, lift and walk your way there.*
